title: 10 How we may know that the holy Ghoſt dwelleth in vs.

segments.text: WEE know that wee haue him, by the effectes, or by his benefits and bleſſings in vs, as by the true knowledge of God, by regeneration, faith, and the inchoation or beginning of new obedience; or by a readineſſe and willingneſſe to obay God. Rom. 5.1. Beeing iuſtified by faith, wee haue peace towards God. The loue of god is ſhed in our harts. Againe, we know it by the teſtimony and witneſſe which hee beareth vnto our ſpirit, that we are the Sonnes of god. Moreouer moſt certaine teſtimonies and tokens of the holy Ghoſt dwelling in vs, are, Comfort in the midſt of death, ioy in afflictions, a purpoſe to perſeuere in faith, ſighes, and ardent praiers, a ſincere profeſſing of Chriſtianitie. 1. Corint. 12.3. No man can ſaie that Ieſus is the Lord, but by the holy ghoſt. In a woorde, by faith and repentaunce, we know that the holie Ghoſt dwelleth in vs.
